pages.title: Nutrient Decay
pages.text:
All nutrition bars $(#e05252)decay passively over time$() regardless of activity. You do not need to be hungry for your bars to drop — time alone drains them.

Decay rate is configurable by server owners. By default, bars drain over the course of roughly one in-game day.

pages.title: Staying Ahead
pages.text:
The key is to eat $(bold)proactively$(), not reactively. Do not wait until a bar is empty to address it — top up groups regularly throughout the day as part of normal play.

A diverse farm makes this effortless. A single meal covering three or four groups goes a long way.
